states: Private mock stack (8 nodes, each with a linked Pulse agent): Vite dev server on this exact staged frontend tree, backend built from the same tree with a local-only generator overlay (never committed) pinning West Production A/B/C NVMe disks at 72C and a pve3 SATA disk at 41C. Each disk's parent is its node's merged agent machine (agent IDs host-node-mock-cluster-1-pve1/2/3)
Overrides set through GET/PUT /api/alerts/config: host-node-mock-cluster-1-pve1 diskTemperature 80/75, host-node-mock-cluster-1-pve3 disabled; pve2 none. diskTempByType nvme 70/65

Same-session control with the changed runtime files swapped to origin/main under the running Vite (then restored, full diff cmp-identical): all three NVMe disks read 'Running Hot' with red 72C cells, including pve1 under its 80C override (detail: 'Disk temperature is 72°C, at or above its 70°C alert threshold.') and pve3 with alerts off

After, 1440: pve1 NVMe 72C 'Healthy' with a green cell (rgb(22,163,74)); pve2 NVMe 72C 'Running Hot' with a red cell (rgb(220,38,38)); pve3 NVMe 72C uncoloured (text-base-content) and not hot (its mock SMART health is UNKNOWN, so the verdict reads 'Unknown'), and pve3's other disks lose their threshold colour too; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 1440)
After, 375: same verdicts in compact form (pve1 'Healthy' green, pve2 'Hot' red, pve3 uncoloured); scrollWidth 375
After, inline disk detail for pve1's NVMe: health 'Healthy' and Temperature 72°C, agreeing with its row

After, override moved to pve2's linked Proxmox node ID (mock-cluster-1-pve2, diskTemperature 80/75): pve2's NVMe reads 'Healthy' with a green cell, as CheckHost inherits a linked-node override; config restored afterwards

Not reachable on the mock estate and covered by unit tests instead: pool-drawer linked disks (storagePoolDetailPresentation/useStoragePoolDetailModel tests), the guest drawer for an agent merged into a VM (GuestPhysicalDisks.test.tsx), and the owner walk through an Unraid pool (physicalDiskAlertOwner.test.ts)
interactions: Loaded Physical Disks filtered to West Production at 1440x900 and 375x812 and read each pinned row's verdict, Temp cell class and computed colour, before (main frontend) and after
Clicked pve1's NVMe row to open its inline disk detail and read its health and temperature
Changed alert overrides through GET/PUT /api/alerts/config (host-keyed, then node-keyed) and reloaded Physical Disks after each
Measured document scrollWidth at both widths
